steps.content: You want to keep looking, but you hear a familiar man's voice humming out of tune from outside the door. He happily opens the door, his face beaming brightly.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Oh hey, you're finally awake. Where'd you party last night to end up this wasted?

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Have some of the hangover drink to clear up your stomach. We're going to have a big meal in a bit. Not to brag, but my wife is the best cook in the world!

steps.speaker: Nasha
steps.content: Doyle, come help.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Roger that, commander!
He quickly changes into his slippers and shuffles toward the kitchen, but you grab him.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: What is it?
You don't have time to beat around the bush. You get straight to the point.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Wake up, Inspector. Time is running out.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're trapped in a dream. You ingested Ambrosia in the real world and fell into this Sleepwalking state.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: What are you talking about? Are you still drunk or something? You're the one who was craving my wife's cooking all the time. You insisted on coming over to eat these past couple weeks.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I didn't even know you two weeks ago. You've been working on this case, and got attacked yesterday.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: District 14 is in grave danger. You have to wake up and help me find the Sinner hiding in your dreams, or else more people will become victims.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: What are you talking about? Did you lose your mind? Nasha and I have been preparing this meal for you all day.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: You split up with her a long time ago.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: What the **** are you talking about?!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: You know what I'm talking about.

steps.content: You pick up the TV remote and turn up the volume. The looping news broadcast disturbs the peace in the house.

steps.speaker: TV Newscast
steps.content: ...The impact of the incident at the Midsummer Night's Club continues to worsen. Dozens have gone missing...

steps.speaker: TV Newscast
steps.content: ...The cause of the incident remains unclear... The FAC's counter-Mania defense line has been impacted. If it is damaged, the Sleepwalking phenomenon will quickly spread to cover all of District 14...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: This is your subconscious warning you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Try to remember! This is your case!

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Enough!
Doyle grabs the remote control and throws it hard at the TV. With an earsplitting crack, the screen goes dark, leaving only a long spiderweb-like fissure.

steps.speaker: Nasha
steps.content: What's wrong?
"Nasha" walks out of the kitchen and looks at you two in worry. In this instant, a frightened look flashes on Doyle's face. A wisp of black smoke floats out from the TV screen, and the fissure heals.

steps.speaker: Nasha
steps.content: Do you have work... Or are you fighting?

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: No, it's fine. ${PlayerName} suddenly realized he needs to leave to work on a case. I'll see him out.
steps.female_content: No, it's fine. ${PlayerName} suddenly realized she needs to leave to work on a case. I'll see her out.

steps.speaker: Nasha
steps.content: Dinner's ready though. Aren't you going to eat something before leaving?

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: A workaholic like him won't appreciate it. This case is urgent. He's not gonna stay.
steps.female_content: A workaholic like her won't appreciate it. This case is urgent. She's not gonna stay.

steps.speaker: Nasha
steps.content: Then... what about you?
Behind her is a table full of delicious food, which must have taken a long time to prepare.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: I'll stay and eat, of course. I'm not him. I'm married to you, not my work.
steps.female_content: I'll stay and eat, of course. I'm not her. I'm married to you, not my work.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Wait for me.
You open your mouth to say something, but Doyle grabs you by the collar and drags you to the door.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: What the **** do you want to say?!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: She's not real. None of this is.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: This is real. This is the most important thing in the world to me. I'll never let go!

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: **** work, **** the case. They're nothing compared to her. I won't make the wrong choice again.
His eyes are full of fear. The man is deeply immersed in the dream already. You have no time to wake him up.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Get lost!
Doyle pushes you out the door and slams the door shut. He has expelled you.
Outside the door is icy darkness, from which you hear a faint sneer.
Why bring this upon yourself? Why try to snatch others from their sweet dreams?
A hint of sweet aroma lingers in the darkness.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Show yourself. I know you're here.

steps.content: Haha... It's just a little warm-up performance. Don't be mad...
Plus, aren't you the fool who disturbs others' dreams?
The dreamy performance is about to start. Welcome, dreamless one. I saved you a VIP seat.
